panels.title: Consensus — is the fleet on one chain?
Fleet Height
panels.description: Highest block seen anywhere in the fleet.

panels.title: Height Spread
panels.description: Highest minus lowest instance. Anything sustained above a couple of blocks means something is lagging or stuck.

panels.title: Distinct Chains
panels.description:
Distinct block hashes reported at the same checkpoint height. 1 = the fleet agrees. >1 = FORK.

Grouped by checkpoint_height on purpose: comparing each node's own tip-minus-depth made nodes a block apart look like separate chains, and read 3 on a fleet that was provably in consensus.

panels.title: Instances Up
panels.description: pivxd instances answering RPC.

panels.title: In IBD
panels.description: Instances still in initial block download. IBD suppresses address gossip, so anything parked here goes stale.

panels.title: Instances Down
panels.description: Instances not answering RPC.

panels.title: Block Height by Host
panels.description: Per-host max height. Lines should be indistinguishable; a line peeling off is a stuck node.

panels.title: Height Spread Over Time
panels.description: Sustained non-zero means a node is not keeping up.

panels.title: Instances Behind the Tip
panels.description: Every instance not at fleet max height, and by how many blocks. Empty table is the healthy state.

panels.title: Chain Fingerprint by Instance
panels.description: Block hash fingerprint 10 blocks below the tip. All instances should show the SAME value — group by Value to see a fork split.

panels.title: IPv4 Cohort
panels.description: Live IPv4 instances. LLMQ minSize is 40.

panels.title: IPv6 Cohort
panels.description: Live IPv6 instances. LLMQ minSize is 40.

panels.title: Tor Cohort
panels.description: Live Tor instances. LLMQ minSize is 40.

panels.title: Masternodes Enabled
panels.description: Enabled masternodes as the network sees them (max across instances, since nodes sync the list at different rates).

panels.title: MN Total
panels.description: Total masternodes in the list.

panels.title: Zero-Inbound (MN-capable)
panels.description:
MN-capable instances with outbound peers but zero inbound. Excludes v4-mn02 and the observer, which share a host address on a non-default port and can never be masternodes — counting them made this read 23 when only 7 mattered.

A small non-zero value here is expected, not a fault: ThreadOpenConnections allows only ONE outbound per netgroup (net.cpp:1807, eclipse protection), and this fleet packs 115 masternodes behind ~14 netgroups (IPv4 /16, IPv6 /32). Instances that lose the race for their group's slot get no organic inbound. They are still dialable, and quorum connections use a separate path (m_masternode_connection) that bypasses this entirely.

Investigate if it climbs sharply or a whole cohort goes to zero.

targets.expr: count(pivxd_peers_inbound == 0 and on(pivx_instance) pivxd_up{mn_capable="1"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Live Instances by Cohort
panels.description: Cohort sizes over time, against the minSize 40 a DKG needs.

panels.title: Masternode Count
panels.description: Registered masternodes by network class.

panels.title: Peers by Cohort (avg)
panels.description: Average connected peers per cohort.

panels.title: Inbound vs Outbound (fleet)
panels.description: A healthy overlay has substantial inbound. Inbound collapsing to zero means the fleet has become undialable.

panels.title: Peer Ping by Cohort
panels.description: Round-trip to peers. Tor should sit well above clearnet — this is the latency that will shape DKG timing.

panels.title: Mempool Transactions
panels.description: Unconfirmed transactions across the fleet.

panels.title: Difficulty
panels.description: PoW difficulty. Rises while mining faster than target spacing, falls during idle gaps.

panels.title: Banned Peers
panels.description: Total bans fleet-wide. Nodes banning each other is a misbehaviour loop, not hostile peers.

panels.title: Miner Spendable
panels.description: Largest spendable balance in the fleet — the bootstrap miner wallet.

panels.title: Miner Immature
panels.description: Coinbase awaiting the 15-block maturity.

panels.title: Metrics Age (s)
panels.description: Oldest collector write. A dead collector serves stale values forever and every chain panel silently lies, so watch this.

panels.title: Collector Duration
panels.description: Slowest host's collection pass.

panels.title: Hosts Reporting
panels.description: Hosts producing chain metrics.

panels.title: Total Instances
panels.description: pivxd instances known to the collector.

panels.title: Total Supply
panels.description: Total PIV in existence as of the supply index height (see Index Lag).

panels.title: Transparent
panels.description: Transparent (non-shielded) supply.

panels.title: Shielded
panels.description: Sapling shielded pool.

panels.title: Supply Index Height
panels.description: Height the supply figures describe. getsupplyinfo is cached and is NOT recalculated on every call — forcing it walks the UTXO set.

panels.title: Index Lag (blocks)
panels.description: Chain height minus supply index height. Large lag means the supply numbers above describe an old block, not the tip.

panels.title: Supply Over Time
panels.description: Emission is deterministic: 60,001 in block 1 then 250,000 per block through the PoW window. Any step that does not match is an inflation bug.

panels.title: Emission Rate (PIV/hour)
panels.description: Rate of new coin. Flat while idle; steps up while mining. A non-zero rate with no mining running would mean unexpected issuance.

panels.title: Supply Agreement Across Fleet
panels.description: Both should be zero once instances settle on the same index height. Supply stddev > 0 while index stddev == 0 means nodes at the SAME height disagree on how much money exists — a consensus bug.

panels.title: Supply vs Expected (PoW window)
panels.description: Difference between reported supply and the deterministic PoW emission formula. Should sit exactly at 0 until PoS activates at block 201, after which the formula no longer applies and this panel is expected to drift.
